# Net-replacement scenarios S1 / S2 / S3 (item 2; generated by tools/replacement_scenarios.py)

Current defaults, near-term join `market_excess`; only the scenario changes. Net replacement = demolition (0.135%/yr, BRANZ SR214) + residual. Long run 1991-2023: 0.101%/yr (residual -0.034%, i.e. net unconsented additions); 2018-2023 interval: 0.312%/yr. Stock end-2025: 2,107,606 dwellings.

## Against the 2026 excess (reported, NOT fitted)
